title: This Tiny Sea Creature Punches Faster Than a Bullet
titles: This Tiny Sea Creature Punches Faster Than a Bullet
Why the Mantis Shrimp Has the Deadliest Punch in the Ocean
The Animal With Eyes That Can See Impossible Colors
hook: This shrimp punches faster than a bullet.

scenes.text: This shrimp punches faster than a bullet.
Its club-like claw accelerates at an incredible rate.
It hits with so much force that it boils surrounding water.
The collapsing bubbles create a second shockwave that stuns prey.
They can inflict painful wounds if handled incautiously.
However, their vision is even more extreme.
Humans have four visual pigments compared to the many more found in mantis shrimp.
These mantis shrimp have up to sixteen.
They see deep ultraviolet and polarized light we cannot
